Remark
[a Riccati inequality for Jacobi fields]

Source: petersen:page-0284 ↗ def:pet-ch6-jacobi-field 1. ch6:6.7.11Let $J$ be a nontrivial Jacobi field along a unit speed geodesic $c$ with $J(0)=0$, $\dot J(0)\perp \dot c(0)$, and suppose $\sec \le K$. (1) With $\lambda =|J|^2/g(J,\dot J)$, show $\dot\lambda \le 1+K\lambda ^2$, $\lambda (0)=0$ while $\lambda $ is defined. (2) Show that if $J(b)=0$ for some $b>0$, then $g(J(t),\dot J(t))=0$ for some $t\in (0,b)$; give an explicit example.
